general.heading: Household details
general.readOnly: Only the owner and admins can change them.

delete.title: Delete household
delete.lead: Deleting removes memberships, invitations, bots and the change log. This cannot be undone.
delete.body: All members will lose access, and bot tokens will stop working.

members.title: Members
members.lastOwner: A household must have at least one owner. Give this role to someone else first.
members.leadManage: The role decides what a household member can do. Add new people on the Invitations tab.
members.lead: People with access to this household.

leaveDialog.title: Leave household {{name}}?
leaveDialog.body: You will lose access to the household data. You can only come back with a new invitation.
leaveDialog.bots: Bots you created will be disabled.

removeDialog.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeDialog.body: {{name}} will lose access to the household.
removeDialog.bots: Bots created by this person will be disabled.

invitations.leadEmail: You will get a single-use link. Denar can also email it to the invited person.
invitations.leadNoEmail: You will get a single-use link. Pass it on to the invited person — this server has no email configured.

empty.title: No invitations yet
empty.body: Invited people will appear here together with the invitation status.

invitations.sendLink: Send this link to {{email}}. It works once, until {{date}}.
invitations.emailFailedBody: {{error}}. The invitation was created — pass the link on yourself.
invitations.linkOnce: The link is shown only now. After closing this window you can generate a new one.

form.label: New invitation
form.sendEmailHint: You will see the link after creating it anyway — you can also pass it on yourself.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke the invitation?
revokeDialog.body: The link sent to {{email}} will stop working.

bots.heading: Bots and AI assistants
bots.lead: A bot gets a token for the API and MCP. It sees only what its scopes allow — and never more than the person who created it.

empty.title: No bots yet
empty.body: A bot lets an AI assistant (e.g. Claude over MCP) or your own script read reports and record expenses on your behalf.

row.label: Bot {{name}}
row.inactiveTitle: The creator's current role does not grant this scope
row.updateFailed: Could not change the bot. Try again.

form.futureDate: Choose a date in the future.
form.duplicate: A bot with this name already exists. Choose another one.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: The name identifies the bot in the change log, e.g. “Claude”, “Bank import”.

token.title: Token of bot {{name}}
token.onceTitle: The token is shown only once
token.onceBody: Copy it now and keep it somewhere safe (e.g. a password manager). Once you close this window it cannot be recovered — you can only generate a new one. It will also disappear from the assistant connection commands below.
token.label: Token
token.hint: The bot identifies itself with the header Authorization: Bearer <token> — in the REST API and in MCP.

rotate.title: New token for {{name}}?
rotate.body: The current token stops working immediately. Enter the new one wherever the bot is used.

delete.title: Delete bot {{name}}?
delete.body: The token will stop working. The bot's change log entries will remain.

walletScope.required: Choose at least one wallet or allow all of them.
walletScope.restrictedHint: Without a restriction the bot sees every wallet its creator sees (including ones added later).
walletScope.none: You cannot see any wallets yet.
walletScope.hidden_one: Plus {{count}} wallet hidden from you (left unchanged).
walletScope.hidden_other: Plus {{count}} wallets hidden from you (left unchanged).

prompts.renewals: What renews this week and how much does it cost?
prompts.envelope: How much is left in my “Groceries” envelope this month?
prompts.spending: What did I spend the most on last month?
prompts.expense: I spent 42.50 at the grocery store with my card, on groceries.

assistant.title: Connect to an AI assistant
assistant.lead: Denar has an MCP server — an assistant (e.g. Claude) uses it to read data and record expenses with this bot's scopes. The commands below contain the token, so copy them now too.
assistant.insecureBody: The token will travel over the network unencrypted. Serve Denar over HTTPS (e.g. behind a reverse proxy) before connecting an assistant from outside this computer.
assistant.remoteHttp: Client with remote MCP (HTTP with headers)
assistant.remoteHttpHint: E.g. Claude Code's .mcp.json file or the Cursor configuration.
assistant.mcpRemoteHint: E.g. claude_desktop_config.json in Claude Desktop. Requires Node.js (npx).

payees.title: Payees
payees.lead: Shops, companies and people you deal with. A new payee is created automatically when you enter it in a transaction. Patterns recognise it in bank descriptions (e.g. “BIEDRONKA” in “BIEDRONKA 1234 WARSZAWA”).

empty.title: No payees yet
empty.body: They will appear when you enter a payee in a transaction, or you can add them here.

form.name: Name
form.duplicate: A payee with this name already exists.
form.patternsHint: One per line. A text fragment, case-insensitive, e.g. ORLEN.
form.defaultEnvelopeHint: An expense at this payee without a chosen envelope goes to this envelope.

deleteDialog.title: Delete payee {{name}}?
deleteDialog.body: Transactions will remain, but without a payee.

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.lead: Foreign currency transactions are converted to {{base}} at the NBP average rate for the transaction date (or the last business day before it). Without access to NBP a transaction waits for a rate — you can then set it manually.

quote.missingBody: There is no {{currency}} rate for {{date}}. Transactions in this currency from that day will wait for a rate.

set.title: Set a rate manually
set.lead: The rate applies only in this household and only on that day. It fills in the {{base}} amounts of transactions waiting for a rate from that day; it does not change transactions already converted.

audit.title: Change log
audit.lead: Who changed what in the household and when — people, bots and system jobs. Newest first.
audit.loadFailed: Could not load the change log

empty.title: No entries
empty.body: Every change in the household will appear here.

connections.title: Connections
connections.lead: Automatic import of transactions from banks and provider accounts. Fetched operations go through the same import as CSV files: duplicates are skipped and payees are matched by rules.

empty.title: No connections
empty.body: Integrations with banks and providers (PSD2, OpenAI, Apple) will come in future versions; for now use the CSV import — a bank statement lands in a wallet in a few clicks.

providers.title: Providers on this server
providers.none: No provider is available yet. Future versions of Denar will add banks (PSD2 via an aggregator) and OpenAI and Apple accounts.
